$comment: Default campaign config. Used by `pnpm spire outreach campaign create` to populate from-name/from-email/reply-to-email and the warmup-week-1 daily cap. Once a campaign is created in Neon, this file is reference-only — the row is the source of truth and can be edited via SQL or CLI.

campaigns.name: unifyone broken-link replacement v1
campaigns.rationale: Highest reply-rate campaign type (8-15%). Crawler-driven; runs after spire_broken_links is populated.

campaigns.name: unifyone resource-page asks v1
campaigns.rationale: Moderate reply rate (3-6%). Targets curated /resources, /tools, /best-X pages.

campaigns.name: unifyone guest-post pitches v1
campaigns.rationale: Lowest reply rate (1-3%) but highest authority payoff. Stays manual indefinitely per Batch 06 spec.

warmup_curve.$comment: Per-campaign daily caps. Bump weekly via `pnpm spire outreach campaign-cap --campaign <id> --cap <n>` during warmup. Going faster torches the sending domain.

compliance.$comment: CAN-SPAM: physical address in every footer; one-click unsubscribe; no false subjects. Append the footer in the worker, not in the prompt.
